name: Haibara Towa
source:
The head maid from Haibara family, who have served the Hinomori family for generations.

Her husband is an adopted son-in-law who works outside the estate, so they're estranged, meeting only about once a year.

She's usually a kind, capable woman who takes good care of others, but for some reason, despite being married, she harbors wicked, indecent feelings toward [url=/c156628]Masaaki[/url] and tries to seduce him.

She is in her late 30s. 

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1343034]Getchu[/url]]
